title Gimnasio Cantera - inside the rock gym: a steady pulse on D that grows eight bars (D minor, a tritone leans on it), a snare roll, and it starts again
tempo 120
vol 235
meter 4/4
inst p1 v=120,80,60
inst p2 v=170,120,90
inst p3 v=220,160,120
inst p4 v=255,200,150
inst kick drum=g5 v=255,200,140 d=0,-45,-75
inst snr drum=a6 noise=25 seed=4 fall=12
l8
# --- the pulse alone, then the beat
@p1 o5 [ d ]8 [ d ]8 |
@p2 [ !kick:d d d e- ]4 |
# --- the tritone leans in
@p3 [ !kick:d d a- d !snr:d d e- d ]2 |
# --- it climbs, the snare rolls, and it breaks off
@p4 d e- e f f+ g a- a |
b- b o6 c c+ d d d d |
[ !snr=4 ]2 !snr=5 !snr=5 !snr=5 !snr=5
